reset_landing.reason: the RTL lands every regional reset port: rst_n_<r> has ONE sink, u_lpr_<r> (r11: kept ot_pl_land_reset_forest DEPTH 3 on ck_<r> beside its pin: prefix + branch landing stages + one leaf per landing chunk; lp.py regional_reset_ports + landing_reset_forest, priced in the landed record: reset release +3); a kit landing would add 2 unpriced release edges

safe_design_checklist.1_pins: PASS: every input lands on a child pin register (head c_* stage) or a landing ring; every output leaves a child register; each regional reset port lands on its own root (kept forest u_lpr_<r> prefix -> branch -> leaf = 3 stages, + u_lprc_u_<r> 4 stages, lp regional_reset_ports + landing_reset_forest); reset only on control/valid (selectors, counters, valid; ring data unreset); both chains in their root's one strip box; command / status / clock / reset ports straight under / over their leaf pins
safe_design_checklist.2_reach: FIXED r14 (lp13a: 312 u_c1-3/cfg_data endpoints -216 ps after repair, -631 before: read o -> cfg pin 520 um across the L macro in one cycle): EVERY leaf (bottom MX, top R0) turn their CFG face (cfg / start / length / rst_n pins) to the boundary strip, so every read half of those roots sits 10-50 um from its pins; head ring -> leaf read = the E = 3 multicycle landing (<= ~2 mm, repeated); the leaf's command bits (child-registered, +4 edges) cross the leaf to their ports, its status bits (l_fault / l_valid, child-registered) cross to their write rings in the strip: one repeated single-cycle hop <= ~540 um, inside the measured 600-750 um repeated reach
safe_design_checklist.3_fanout: PASS (r11 RTL unchanged, lp14 = lp10 + command_c9 width): landings chunked at 8 bits with kept per-chunk one-hot selectors (slot enable 2 x 12 + 1 = 25 loads), each chunk reset from its own forest leaf, forest prefix -> <= 2 branches, branch -> <= 32 leaves; pre-gate native census decides (numbers in the gate packet)
safe_design_checklist.4_depth: PASS: landing read = 8:1 registered slot mux (lp ot_pl_land_r); no combinational in -> out path (all child-registered)
safe_design_checklist.5_storage: PASS: ring banks are D = 8 slot landings (fixed-latency rings, not runtime-indexed storage); leaf storage is SRAM in the hard leaves
safe_design_checklist.6_floorplan: PASS (r13 outline kept, no squeeze): 1900.8 x 1036.8, both boundary strips 86.4 tall, each leaf root's whole soft cluster in ONE 43.2-tall box in its strip (32.4 clear of the macro, ~8% box util), channel 151.2 with the head + h band; children on the 43.2 lattice; fill 52%; aspect 1.83; child faces <= 3.5 pins/um
safe_design_checklist.7_clock: FIXED r14: 11 regional roots, each compact (entry pin, reset port and the whole soft cluster within ~60 um; a flipped leaf's clock pin is reached by one buffered macro trunk across the leaf); ck_h (lp13a 87.8 TT / 83.5 FF: TritonCTS balances the soft tree to the child's LATEST boundary flop, the 3,412-sink head cluster landed 40-50 ps after pghead's range) gets the post-CTS child_centre_tap on u_h/clk (offline on the lp13a 4_1_cts copy: 1 BUFx4 -> 58.2 TT / 61.9 FF); landed crossings between every pair; io_hold_margin 0.03; hard-child references from views/<child>/insertion.json.
